source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Whenever this unit is the target of an attack and its models have differing T characteristics, the roll needed to wound uses the T that most of its models have, until the attacking models finish their attacks; if there is a tie for the majority, take the highest of the tied values. When checking which models of this unit fit inside a TRANSPORT, each Gravis Veteran model counts as 2 models for space, but may otherwise ride in any TRANSPORT its unit is allowed to embark within, despite comparable models in other units carrying the GRAVIS keyword.

woundToughness.use: T of the majority of models
woundToughness.until: the attacking models have finished making their attacks

transport.mayEmbarkIn: any TRANSPORT this unit can embark within
transport.despite: similar models in other units have GRAVIS
